proposals.hypothesis: All user journeys (browse, cart, checkout) will be broken due to the frontend being the entry point. Expected high error rates (>50%) and elevated p95 latency (>1000ms) across all journeys.
proposals.reason: Frontend is the entry point for all user journeys (browse, cart, checkout). This experiment reveals the system's resilience at the critical entry layer. We have not run service-down on frontend (only pod-kill was tested).

proposals.hypothesis: Cart journey and checkout journey will be broken due to cart management failure. Expected high error rates (>50%) and elevated p95 latency (>1000ms) in cart-related flows.
proposals.reason: Cartservice is stateful (uses redis-cart) and critical for two journeys. We have not run pod-kill on it (only service-down was tested). This reveals how cart data is handled during failures.

proposals.hypothesis: Browse journey and checkout journey will be broken due to product data unavailability. Expected high error rates (>50%) and elevated p95 latency (>1000ms) in product-related flows.
proposals.reason: Productcatalogservice has high fan-in (3 callers) and impacts two journeys. We have not run pod-kill on it (only service-down was tested). This reveals product data resilience.

proposals.hypothesis: Checkout journey will be broken due to shipping failure. Expected high error rates (>50%) in checkout flows.
proposals.reason: Shippingservice is critical for checkout journeys. We have not run pod-kill on it (only service-down was tested). This reveals checkout process resilience.
